traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets disruption. Attraction to unconventional ideas and systems of thought. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Seen as forward-thinking and ahead of the curve; you get away with it. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize growth and disruption into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what growth and disruption have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Innovative thinking whose reception depends heavily on how it's framed.
shadow: The ease lets excess and overreach and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.summary: One change in the way you have been doing things can create much more possibility than you expected it to.
readerCopy.body: One change in the way you have been doing things can create much more possibility than you expected it to. When Jupiter sextiles Uranus, a new idea, connection, tool, or exception can remove a limitation that had quietly been determining how far you could go. The opening may look small compared with the larger goal, but that is part of what makes it useful. Follow the option that gives you more room and see how much of the old limit was actually necessary once another route exists.
